spans.s:
Nihākā in the Rigveda and the taittirīya Saṃhitā appears to denote some phenomenon of a storm, perhaps the ‘whirlwind.’
Foot notes x. 97, 13.
vii. 5, 11, 1 (following nīhāra).

Nīhāra, ‘mist,’ occurs in the Rigveda and later.
Foot notes x. 82, 7.
taittirīya Saṃhitā, vii. 5, 11, 1; kāṭhaka Saṃhitā, xxviii. 4; Vājasaneyi Saṃhitā, xxii. 26; xxv. 9; Av. vi. 113, 2; xviii. 3, 60; taittirīya Āraṇyaka, i. 10, 7; vi. 4, 1; Chāndogya upaniṣad, iii. 19, 2, etc.
